{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
sales_df = pd.read_csv('/home/musel/Github/research_agent/data/sales.csv')

# Redefine conversion as status == 'completed'
sales_df['conversion'] = (sales_df['status'] == 'completed').astype(int)

# Compute conversion rates within each customer segment
stratified_rates = sales_df.groupby(['channel', 'customer_segment'])['conversion'].mean().unstack(level='channel')

# Compute difference in conversion rates within each segment
stratified_diff = stratified_rates['email'] - stratified_rates['paid_search']

# Get overall segment distribution (across all users)
overall_segment_dist = sales_df['customer_segment'].value_counts(normalize=True)

# Compute weighted average difference
weighted_diff = (stratified_diff * overall_segment_dist).sum()

# Also compute the raw difference for comparison
raw_diff = sales_df[sales_df['channel'] == 'email']['conversion'].mean() - \
           sales_df[sales_df['channel'] == 'paid_search']['conversion'].mean()

print("Stratified conversion rates by channel and segment:")
print(stratified_rates)

print("\nDifference in conversion rates (email - paid_search) within each segment:")
print(stratified_diff)

print("\nOverall segment distribution (weights):")
print(overall_segment_dist)

print(f"\nWeighted average difference (adjusted for segment imbalance): {weighted_diff}")
print(f"\nRaw difference (unadjusted): {raw_diff}")"}
